briefings.title: 'He Is Uniquely Unqualified To Lead': Elizabeth Warren Drops The Hammer On Fed Chair Nom Kevin Warsh
briefings.tldr: Senator Elizabeth Warren is urging the Senate to reject Kevin Warsh’s nomination for Federal Reserve Chair, arguing he is a "sock puppet" for President Trump who lacks the independence, transparency, and historical judgment necessary to lead the nation’s central bank.

briefings.title: Sen. Elizabeth Warren on Fed chair nominee Kevin Warsh, financial regulation and Iran
briefings.tldr: Senator Elizabeth Warren characterized Fed chair nominee Kevin Warsh as a "sock puppet" for Donald Trump, arguing his refusal to demonstrate independence disqualifies him, while simultaneously defending her regulatory record against accusations that she "killed" community banking.

briefings.title: BREAKING: Warren Sounds Alarm About Kevin Warsh Post-Meeting, Says His Name Appears In Epstein Files
briefings.tldr: Senator Elizabeth Warren is calling for the postponement of Kevin Warsh’s Federal Reserve chairmanship hearing, citing his failure to disclose $100 million in assets and unexplained appearances in the Jeffrey Epstein files.
